definitions.gloss: exchange meeting, social gathering, networking event, mixer
definitions.explanation: A gathering organized for people to meet, interact, and share ideas or experiences. Used for cultural exchange events, professional networking, community meetups, and similar social occasions.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{交流会|こうりゅうかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I participated in an international exchange event.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{交流会|こうりゅうかい}で{新|あたら}しい{友人|ゆうじん}ができた。
examples.english: I made new friends at a community social gathering.

examples.japanese: {留学生|りゅうがくせい}と{日本人|にほんじん}{学生|がくせい}の{交流会|こうりゅうかい}が{毎月|まいつき}{開催|かいさい}されており、{文化|ぶんか}の{違|ちが}いについて{話|はな}し{合|あ}う{良|よ}い{機会|きかい}になっている。
examples.english: An exchange event for international and Japanese students is held monthly, providing a good opportunity to discuss cultural differences.

notes:
A compound of {交流|こうりゅう} (exchange, interaction) and {会|かい} (meeting, gathering). Very common in Japanese social and professional life. Can range from casual neighborhood get-togethers to formal professional networking events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交流会|こうりゅうかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an exchange event
- {交流会|こうりゅうかい}に{参加|さんか}する: to attend an exchange event
- {国際|こくさい}{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: international exchange meeting
- {異業種|いぎょうしゅ}{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: cross-industry networking event
- {親睦|しんぼく}{交流会|こうりゅうかい}: social get-together

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懇親会|こんしんかい}: social gathering, reception — typically with food and drinks, more party-like
- {親睦会|しんぼくかい}: friendship gathering — emphasis on deepening bonds between existing members
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}: study group — focused on learning rather than socializing
